package frontend

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/backend"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestPulseSubsecondDiscovery(t *testing.T) {
	raw, err := os.ReadFile("/tmp/pulse-windowed-discovery/span-time.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var span struct {
		Start uint32 `json:"start"`
		End   uint32 `json:"end"`
	}
	if err = json.Unmarshal(raw, &span); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	meta := &backend.BlockMeta{}
	meta.ObjectAdded(span.Start, span.End)
	type Case struct {
		Start      int64 `json:"start"`
		End        int64 `json:"end"`
		Included   bool  `json:"included"`
		BlockStart int64 `json:"block_start"`
		BlockEnd   int64 `json:"block_end"`
	}
	cases := []Case{}
	for _, window := range [][2]int64{{19, 19}, {19, 20}, {20, 20}, {20, 21}, {21, 21}} {
		selected := blockMetasForSearch([]*backend.BlockMeta{meta}, time.Unix(window[0], 0), time.Unix(window[1], 0), func(*backend.BlockMeta) bool { return true })
		cases = append(cases, Case{window[0], window[1], len(selected) == 1, meta.StartTime.Unix(), meta.EndTime.Unix()})
	}
	raw, err = json.MarshalIndent(cases, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = os.WriteFile("/tmp/pulse-windowed-discovery/subsecond-routing.json", append(raw, '\n'), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !cases[2].Included {
		t.Fatal(cases)
	}
}
